text: Insect pests and protection (អំពីសត្វល្អិតចង្រៃ និងការការពារ). The source identifies 4 major insect pests as the main threats to this crop (no plant diseases are described in this source — its pest/protection section covers insect pests only). General integrated prevention practices recommended: (1) variety selection — some varieties are inherently more resistant/tolerant, reducing pest pressure; (2) field sanitation — clearing weeds in and around the field removes pest breeding/hiding habitat; (3) combining all recommended control measures together (variety choice, sanitation, monitoring, and targeted chemical control when needed) gives the best overall effectiveness, rather than relying on any single method alone.
